notes: Aisha and Ibn Abbas only send Imran on («ائت ابن عباس»، «سل ابن عمر»); they give no saying, so they are not links. Ibn Umar is the one asked and answers, so he is a link.
«أبو حفص» is written as a bare kunya; the editor gloss «يعني عمر بن الخطاب» is left out.
The second isnad («وقال عبد الله بن رجاء ... حدثني عمران. وقص الحديث») carries the same story and ends at عمران as written; the text does not name Ibn Umar or Umar for it.
